summary: Completed frontend-only Playwright testing of the static IT Niche privacy policy redesign. All 12 functional requirements from the review request verified successfully on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (375x800). No backend, no API calls made, no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero `text-stroke` and `text-stroke-primary` and `tracking-tightest` are custom utility classes — confirm they are defined in App.css/index.css or tailwind.config (visually they appear to render correctly so likely fine).
Footer big name uses `text-[24vw]` which can overflow horizontally on very wide screens — minor, decorative only.
All interactive elements correctly include `data-testid` attributes per the testability guideline.
seed_data_creation: None — purely static frontend, no data required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Single-page static React site at `/`. Components live under /app/frontend/src/components/privacy/*. Verified flows: page load, sticky nav (5 links + Contact Experts CTA), smooth-scroll on nav click (verified by checking section getBoundingClientRect ~0 after click on nav-mailers), hero title shows 'YOUR DATA, HANDLED WITH DISCRETION.', AtAGlance has 5 do-items + 5 dont-items, DataFlow has 4 flow-steps, PolicyGrid has 9 policy-cards, Mailers section with marquee + unsubscribe-link, Footer with footer-cta and footer-bigname (ITNICHE giant typography), mobile menu toggle opens menu and closes on nav click. ZERO `/api/*` network requests observed. ZERO console errors. Logo click scrolls back to top (scrollY=0).
